name: XAI Silo Finance
oneLiner: XAI is Silo Finance's overcollateralized dollar stablecoin, minted by borrowing against approved Silo credit-line collateral such as ETH and USDC.
collateral: Overcollateralized Silo credit-line collateral. XAI launched backed by ETH and USDC silos and SiloDAO progressively approved further credit lines (stETH/wstETH, cbETH, wBTC, USDT, LUSD, FXS, BAL, LQTY, gOHM); SiloDAO governs which collaterals and credit-line parameters apply
pegMechanism: XAI is borrowed into existence against approved Silo collateral and burned on repayment. It has no dedicated stability module: the soft USD peg relies on arbitrage (borrow/repay always settle at $1, so a sub-$1 market price is repaid at a discount and an above-$1 price is sold) backed by DEX liquidity, while SiloDAO controls minting capacity and the XAI borrow interest rate across silos to manage circulating supply

oracleRisk.summary: Legacy Silo v1 XAI residual debt is multi-silo. At Ethereum block 25627249, nine deprecation-listed markets retained 3,770.32 XAI of totalBorrow (cbETH 91.38% of residual debt). Solvency prices route through legacy PriceProvidersRepository 0x7C2ca9D502f2409BeceAfa68E97a176Ff805029F (quoteToken WETH). XAI debt itself is priced via ChainlinkV3PriceProvider 0xe37B8c83138caF12E57632D19c06Eb561D47e423 using the USDC/ETH aggregator 0x986b5E1e1755e3C2440e960477f25201B0a8bbD4 (heartbeat 87000s) with fallback provider 0x2f0a401966219351887A608493954A7078ef1bc0 — XAI has no independent market oracle. Dominant cbETH collateral uses Chainlink CBETH/ETH with UniswapV3PriceProviderV2 fallback. Permissionless flashLiquidate has no stability-pool backstop; SiloDAO deprecated new XAI mint capacity in 2024.

branchApplicability.rationale: SiloDAO's 2024 deprecation plan listed the XAI credit-line markets and directed credit-line burns, but residual totalBorrow remains on nine of those silos at Ethereum block 25627249 (sum 3,770.32 XAI). Each debt-bearing silo is an isolated collateral-liquidation branch with its own siloAsset oracle path, LTV/liquidation-threshold config in SiloRepository 0xd998C35B7900b344bbBe6555cc11576942Cf309d, and shared flashLiquidate mechanics. Deprecation-listed markets with zero XAI totalBorrow (LUSD, LQTY, rETH, LINK, CVX, OHM, BAL, wBTC, and related) are explicit inactive exclusions for this review, not missing branches. Inventory is the deprecation market set re-read on-chain; it is not a claim that every historical XAI silo ever created was enumerated beyond that set.

branches.label: cbETH silo residual XAI debt
branches.summary: Dominant residual branch (91.38% of measured XAI totalBorrow). cbETH collateral is priced by Chainlink CBETH/ETH with UniswapV3PriceProviderV2 fallback; XAI debt is valued via the shared USDC/ETH Chainlink feed.

feeds.path: PriceProvidersRepository 0x7C2ca9D502f2409BeceAfa68E97a176Ff805029F -> ChainlinkV3PriceProvider 0xe37B8c83138caF12E57632D19c06Eb561D47e423 assetData(cbETH): aggregator CBETH/ETH 0xF017fcB346A1885194689bA23Eff2fE6fA5C483b heartbeat 87000s, forceFallback false, fallback UniswapV3PriceProviderV2 0xFAe64471ae04068e872C6A73C9F5a255c37dDbDC; XAI debt via same provider aggregator USDC/ETH 0x986b5E1e1755e3C2440e960477f25201B0a8bbD4 heartbeat 87000s fallback 0x2f0a401966219351887A608493954A7078ef1bc0; quoteToken WETH

branches.fallbackBehavior: ChainlinkV3PriceProvider.getPrice uses the aggregator when the answer is positive and updated within heartbeat and forceFallback is false; otherwise it requires a configured fallback provider and reverts if none is set. cbETH and XAI both have non-zero fallback providers at the reviewed block. Emergency manager can forceFallback when aggregator and fallback diverge by at least 10%.

collateralParameters.note: Silo 0x2eaf84b425822edF450fC5FdeEc085f2e5aDa98b; SiloRepository.getMaximumLTV=0.80e18, getLiquidationThreshold=0.85e18 at block 25627249. XAI totalBorrow 3445.327931670684.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Permissionless Silo.flashLiquidate(users, flashReceiverData) seizes under-threshold collateral for an IFlashLiquidationReceiver that must repay the required debt shares in the same flow. ManualLiquidation helper 0x669229276F5625046D6A1017C3258315Ba69c72E exists. protocolLiquidationFee() returned 0 at the reviewed block.
branches.backstop: No stability pool, insurance fund, or protocol bad-debt buyer. Liquidation depends on an external flash receiver supplying XAI repayment.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: SiloDAO deprecation burned unused XAI credit lines and raised borrow rates but defines no global XAI settlement or debt socialization. If flash liquidation is uneconomic, residual XAI debt can remain open inside the isolated silo.

sources.label: XAI verified Ethereum source and ABI

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The sole tracked Ethereum XAI deployment is a verified non-proxy Xai contract. Its source and ABI expose standard ERC-20 transfer and transferFrom, owner-only mint, and holder-only burn; they expose no holder blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary burn, or transfer-stop function. At Ethereum block 25534723, owner() returned 0xE8e8041cB5E3158A0829A19E014CA1cf91098554, whose Safe threshold was 3 of 4 owners with no enabled modules; the token's EIP-1967 implementation slot was zero and its code hash was 0xf4d1a948d4f04ab365bb1311ed7841ccca82915b9e4e94f4f9d9ec0f23a5da1a. Silo's terms can restrict interface use and describe protocol-level rescue scenarios, but do not identify an XAI token holder-transfer control.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review
blacklistabilityReview.upstreamSuppressionRationale: USDC credit-line collateral can carry issuer or protocol risk for XAI backing, but it does not give Circle or Silo authority to freeze an ordinary XAI holder balance or block the reviewed XAI ERC-20 transfer path. This conclusion is limited to the sole tracked Ethereum deployment and does not assert control coverage for unidentified third-party representations.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: XAI has one tracked Ethereum contract, minted natively by Silo credit-line borrowing under the reviewed 3-of-4 Silo owner Safe; no token-specific bridge route exists in reviewed Silo docs and no other chain carries supply. The Across candidate did not resolve to durable XAI supply movement. Scored as single-chain/native.

reserves.name: Legacy XAI Silo credit-line collateral
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Silo V1 isolated lending markets and their collateral depositors

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 of Silo V3 docs, XAI Ethereum contract page, and SiloDAO deprecation proposal (Jan 2024): XAI was a multi-collateral silo stablecoin without a stability module, now deprecated. No current public aggregate collateral snapshot for residual credit lines; envelope remains 100% legacy silo credit-line collateral with ku=100.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Silo isolated-market documentation and the SiloDAO deprecation record; no current issuer snapshot exists
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current per-market collateral balances, collateral identities and weights, residual XAI debt, liquidation liquidity, and wind-down recoveries are not published in a reproducible current snapshot.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The deprecated protocol publishes no current market-level collateral snapshot, so the aggregate cannot be split or linked without fabrication.

providers.name: Silo V1 isolated lending-market contracts on Ethereum (self-custodied smart contracts; no third-party custodian)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: XAI credit-line collateral sits inside Silo V1 isolated lending-market contracts on Ethereum; there is no bank, trust, or third-party custodian, and no bankruptcy-remoteness structure exists for a DeFi lending market, so bankruptcyRemoteness is none. Assets deposited into a Silo market are lendable within that isolated silo by design — that is how borrowers draw XAI credit lines — so deposited collateral can be re-lent inside its own market, recorded here as permitted rehypothecation in the protocol sense. Not known: current per-market collateral balances backing residual XAI debt, how the 2024 SiloDAO deprecation plan treated remaining credit-line collateral, whether deprecated-market collateral was withdrawn or stranded, and any off-chain recovery claim (none is documented).

notices.title: Deprecated credit-line stablecoin
notices.message: SiloDAO approved a plan to deprecate XAI in 2024 and burn/raise credit-line constraints across legacy markets. Residual supply still circulates, but new mint capacity should be treated as governance-dependent wind-down infrastructure rather than an expanding active stablecoin system.
